children: Hamburg-based Skyborn Renewables has full funding for its Gennaker offshore wind project in the German Baltic Sea after it secured a €2.1 billion ($2.5 billion) financing package from a consortium of 16 commercial banks and the European Investment Bank, it said on Friday.

Skyborn said the project was expected to become the largest offshore wind farm in the German Baltic Sea when it enters commercial operation by the end of 2028, with capacity to power around 1 million households annually.
